questions.question:

i. T is just behind P.

ii. V is just in front of Q, who is not the last person.

iii. S is between P and R.

questions.solution: **People: **P, Q, R, S, T, U and V. i. T is just behind P. ii. V is just in front of Q, who is not the last person. iv. There is one person between T and Q.

questions.question: As 'Cataract' is related to 'Ophthalmology', in the same way 'Neurosis' is related to '_______'.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

As **'Cataract'** is related to** 'Ophthalmology', **

__
 
• ***Ophthalmology** is the **study of surgery for treating 'eyes' disorder **and A **cataract **is a **eye disorder.***

Similarly, 

**'Neurosis**' is related to **'Psychology'.**

 
• ***Neurosis** is a **mental illness **and **study of correcting mental illness **is called** Psychology**.*

Hence, the correct answer is **"Psychology".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Neurology** is the branch of medicine concerned with the study and treatment of disorders of the** nervous system. **
 
• **Psychology** is scientific **study of mind and behavior.**

** ♦ Psychotherapy** → A form of *treatment for many mental disorders* is *Psychotherapy. **Psychotherapy is an interpersonal intervention, usually provided by a mental health professional such as a clinical psychologist, that employs any of a range of specific psychological techniques.***

 
• **Sociology i**s the study of **social life, social change, and the social causes and consequences of human behavior.**
 
• **Biology** is defined as the **science of life and living organisms. **

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

8 + 6 × 4 ÷ 2 - 10 = 6
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03f606139c736cc1af8c6f5c78ea44c324f88530185109c0f836e68c8ced7a54.png] 

Given: 8 + 6 × 4 ÷ 2 - 10 = 6

By checking options and substituting accordingly,

(1) + and × 

LHS = 8 × 6 + 4 ÷ 2 - 10 

= 8 × 6 + 2 - 10 

= 48 + 2 - 10

= 50 - 10 

= 40

≠ 6 

LHS ≠ RHS

**(2) - and +**

**LHS = 8 - 6 × 4 ÷ 2 + 10**

**= **8 - 6 × 2 + 10

= 8 - 12 + 10

= 18 - 12

= 6

LHS = RHS

(3) × and ÷ 

LHS = 8 + 6 ÷ 4 × 2 - 10 

= 8 + 1.5 × 2 - 10

= 8 + 3 - 10

= 11 - 10

= 1

≠ 6 

LHS ≠ RHS

(4) × and -

LHS = 8 + 6 - 4 ÷ 2 × 10 

= 8 + 6 - 2 × 10 

= 8 + 6 - 20

= 14 - 20

= - 6

≠ 6 

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, **- and + **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are followed by two conclusions numbered | and II. Assuming the statements to be true even if they do not conform to real-world knowledge, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements. 

**Statements:**

1. All hostels are buildings.

2. Some buildings are palaces.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some palaces are hostels.

Il. No palace is a hostel.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/964daf282f97f95cb08b01ddb2a682f48a34694bcaf86ded660fa7ca648873cf.png] Conclusions:

I. Some palaces are hostels → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

Il. No palace is a hostel → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

But, both these conclusions form complementary pairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**There are two complementary pairs:

(1) All - Some not

(2) No - Some

Hence, **either conclusion I or II follows.**
